claims.claim: OpenAI Files API has a 512MB per file limit for Assistants and GPT conversations
claims.notes: Token cap of 2M tokens per file also applies

claims.claim: OpenAI Uploads API supports files up to 8GB total with 64MB per part
claims.notes: Designed for large file uploads in multiple parts

claims.claim: OpenAI fine-tuning only supports JSONL format with 1GB max size
claims.notes: Specific format requirements for fine-tuning chat/completions models

claims.claim: OpenAI Files API supports purposes: assistants, assistants_output, batch, batch_output, fine-tune, fine-tune-results, vision, user_data, evals
OpenAI Assistants support maximum 20 files per assistant, 512MB each
OpenAI Assistants file search supports: .pdf, .md, .docx, .pptx, .xlsx, .csv, .json, .txt, .html
claims.notes: Some formats like CSV may have issues in practice per community reports

claims.claim: OpenAI vision supports PNG, JPEG, GIF, WEBP images up to 20MB
OpenAI batch files expire after 30 days; other files persist until manually deleted
OpenAI Assistants API is deprecated, shutting down August 26, 2026; replaced by Responses API
Gemini Files API supports up to 2GB per file (increased to 5GB recently) and 20GB per project (increased to 50GB)
Gemini Files API stores files for 48 hours, then automatically deletes them
claims.notes: No manual deletion needed; re-upload required for longer retention

claims.claim: Gemini Files API is available at no cost in all regions where Gemini API is available
claims.notes: Storage is free; only processing incurs costs

claims.claim: Gemini supports inline uploads (<20MB) and Files API (media.upload) for larger files
Gemini supports PDFs up to 50MB or 1000 pages; each page equals ~258 tokens
Gemini supports: PDFs, DOCX, TXT, XLSX, CSV, MP3, M4A, WAV, images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP), video files
claims.notes: Broad multimodal support including audio and video

claims.claim: Gemini uses native vision to understand PDFs including text, images, diagrams, charts, and tables
Gemini enterprise users can select US, EU, or APAC storage regions for compliance
Anthropic Files API is in beta, requires header: anthropic-beta: files-api-2025-04-14
Anthropic offers 100GB storage per organization, 500MB max per file
Anthropic PDF support: 32MB max file size, 100 pages max per document
Anthropic Files API supports: PDF, DOCX, TXT, CSV, Excel (XLSX), Markdown, images (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP)
claims.notes: Some formats must be converted to plain text

claims.claim: Anthropic rejects images larger than 8000x8000px; 20+ images triggers 2000x2000px limit
Anthropic supports up to 100 images per API request (5 per turn on claude.ai)
claims.notes: API has higher limits than web interface

claims.claim: Anthropic uses file_id system: upload once, reference many times via document content blocks
Anthropic converts PDF pages to images for processing, enabling visual understanding
Anthropic file retention is configurable from 0-365 days for enterprise/tenant accounts
Anthropic Files API is not supported on Amazon Bedrock or Google Vertex AI
Gemini offers 1M token context window; ChatGPT offers ~32K for most users; Claude offers large context windows
